## Acronym Information

```

**Full Name** (what the acronym stands for):

- [ ] Networking

**Difficulty** (pick exactly one):

## Proposed Description

> Write 1–5 lines. Be technically precise. Do not copy from Wikipedia or vendor docs.
> Explain what it is, how it works, and why it matters.

```
